name: modal
description: Experimental: manage Modal (modal.com) serverless compute resources — Secrets, Volumes, Queues, Dicts, Environments, Apps and Images — as infrastructure with Pulumi.

modal:index:App.description: A named Modal App, the container that Functions, Images and Sandboxes belong to. The resource creates the empty named App; it does not deploy code. Deleting it stops the App. See https://modal.com/docs/guide/apps.

appId.description: The Modal-assigned identifier of the App.

environment.description: The Modal environment the app lives in. Changing this forces a new resource. When unset, the provider-level environment or the account's default environment is used.

name.description: The app's unique name within its environment. Changing this forces a new resource.

tags.description: Key/value tags set on the app. Updated in place.

tokenId.description: Modal API token ID. Overrides the provider-level tokenId.

tokenSecret.description: Modal API token secret. Overrides the provider-level tokenSecret.

modal:index:Dict.description: A Modal Dict — a durable, named distributed key/value store shared between Modal Functions. The resource manages the Dict object, not its entries. Deleting it deletes every entry. See https://modal.com/docs/guide/dicts.

dictId.description: The Modal-assigned identifier of the Dict.

environment.description: The Modal environment the dict lives in. Changing this forces a new resource. When unset, the provider-level environment or the account's default environment is used.

name.description: The dict's unique name within its environment. Changing this forces a new resource.

tokenSecret.description: Modal API token secret. Overrides the provider-level tokenSecret.

modal:index:Environment.description: A Modal environment — a sub-namespace of a workspace that holds Secrets, Volumes, Queues, Dicts, Apps and Images. Environments are workspace-level. Deleting one deletes everything in it. See https://modal.com/docs/guide/environments.

environmentId.description: The Modal-assigned identifier of the environment.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the workspace's default environment.

maxConcurrentGpus.description: Maximum number of GPUs in use at once in this environment. Unlimited when unset.

maxConcurrentTasks.description: Maximum number of tasks running at once in this environment. Unlimited when unset.

name.description: The environment's name, unique in the workspace. Changing this renames the environment in place.

tokenId.description: Modal API token ID. Overrides the provider-level tokenId.

tokenSecret.description: Modal API token secret. Overrides the provider-level tokenSecret.

webSuffix.description: Suffix of web endpoint URLs created in this environment. Modal assigns one when unset.

webSuffix.description: Suffix of web endpoint URLs created in this environment. Modal assigns one when unset.

modal:index:Image.description: A Modal Image built from a registry base image plus optional Dockerfile commands, optionally published under a stable name. Changing the base image, commands, environment variables, GPU, registry secret or environment builds a new Image and replaces this one. An imported Image keeps whatever it was built from. See https://modal.com/docs/guide/images.

baseImage.description: Registry image to start from, for example "python:3.12-slim". Required when creating an Image. Changing this builds a new Image.

dockerfileCommands.description: Dockerfile instructions applied on top of the base image in a single layer, for example "RUN pip install torch". Changing this builds a new Image.

env.description: Environment variables set in the build environment of the Dockerfile commands layer. Changing this builds a new Image.

environment.description: The Modal environment the Image is built and published in. Changing this forces a new resource. When unset, the provider-level environment or the account's default environment is used.

gpu.description: GPU reserved for the build of the Dockerfile commands layer, for example "T4" or "A100:2". Changing this builds a new Image.

imageId.description: The Modal-assigned identifier of the built Image.

name.description: Publishes the built Image under a stable name, "name" or "name:tag" (tag defaults to latest). Changing this republishes the same Image under the new name.

registrySecret.description: Name of a Modal Secret holding credentials for a private registry. Changing this builds a new Image.

tokenId.description: Modal API token ID. Overrides the provider-level tokenId.

tokenSecret.description: Modal API token secret. Overrides the provider-level tokenSecret.

modal:index:Queue.description: A Modal Queue — a distributed FIFO/LIFO queue for passing data between Modal Functions, Sandboxes, and external callers. See https://modal.com/docs/guide/queues.

environment.description: The Modal environment the queue lives in. Changing this forces a new resource.

name.description: The queue's unique name. Changing this forces a new resource.

tokenId.description: Modal API token ID. Overrides the provider-level tokenId.

modal:index:Secret.description: A durable, named Modal Secret — a collection of key/value pairs Modal Functions mount as environment variables. Modal never returns secret values, so refresh and import can only see key names: after an import, the next update writes the values from your program. See https://modal.com/docs/guide/secrets.

environment.description: The Modal environment the Secret lives in. Changing this forces a new resource. When unset, the provider-level environment or the account's default environment is used.

keys.description: Sorted names of the keys currently stored in the Secret, as last read from Modal.

name.description: The unique Secret name. Changing this forces a new resource.

secretId.description: The Modal-assigned identifier of the Secret.

tokenId.description: Modal API token ID. Overrides the provider-level tokenId.

tokenSecret.description: Modal API token secret. Overrides the provider-level tokenSecret.

values.description: Key/value pairs exposed as environment variables to Functions that mount this Secret. Keys must be valid environment variable names (letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit).

modal:index:Volume.description: A Modal Volume — a persistent, distributed filesystem mountable into Modal Functions and Sandboxes for caching model weights, datasets, or other large files across runs. See https://modal.com/docs/guide/volumes.

environment.description: The Modal environment the volume lives in. Changing this forces a new resource, which deletes the volume's data. When unset, the provider-level environment or the account's default environment is used.

fsVersion.description: Volume filesystem version: "v1" or "v2". Defaults to "v2" (Modal's recommended backend; note that Modal's own SDKs default to "v1"). The effective version is always reported as an output. Changing this forces a new resource and deletes the volume's data: the old volume is deleted before the new one is created because both share a name.

name.description: The volume's unique name within its environment. Changing this renames the volume in place.

tokenId.description: Modal API token ID. Overrides the provider-level tokenId.

tokenSecret.description: Modal API token secret. Overrides the provider-level tokenSecret.
